info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Payments Payments Webhooks-v1-spec
info.description: The Payments Webhook API allows businesses to receive real-time notifications about payment events. This API is designed for developers looking to integrate payment status updates into their applications seamlessly. By subscribing to various payment events, organizations can automate workflows based on actions like payment completions, failures, or refunds. Typical consumers of this API include e-commerce platforms, service providers, and payment processors who need instant visibility into payment transactions.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to receive notifications related to payment events through webhooks. Ensure you have properly set up your endpoint to handle incoming POST requests with the expected payload.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to receive webhook notifications related to payments. The data sent in this request includes information about payment events, allowing the receiving system to process them accordingly.
